primary_endpoint: NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis at 72 weeks; time to long-term composite outcome of all-cause mortality, cirrhosis, and liver-related clinical outcomes.
efficacy_outcome: At 72 weeks, 138 participants receiving 120 mg elafibranor and 52 receiving placebo achieved NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis (p=0.0659).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 190/1,433 participants receiving elafibranor and 95/717 receiving placebo; deaths were 6 and 3, respectively.
